items.title: Chevron (CVX) Has Fresh Attention, But What Is The Market Weighing?
items.summary: Chevron (CVX) is back in focus after new agreements with Venezuela reset the terms of its joint ventures, support over US$7b of planned investment and grant fresh Orinoco Belt acreage. Chevron’s latest Venezuela move comes on top of strong price momentum, with the share price delivering a 1 month return of 10.99%, a 90 day return of 12.82% and a year-to-date return of 35.55%. items.title: Bloomberg Economist: ‘This Was All About Oil’ and Compares Chevron’s Venezuela Deal to 1953 Iran Coup
items.summary: A Bloomberg economist just compared Chevron's blockbuster Venezuela oil deal to a Cold War coup that looked like a triumph for 25 years before costing the U.S. one of its biggest crude suppliers almost overnight. History has a pattern here, and CVX shareholders paying a 52-week-high price may not be priced for it.
